settings.announcement: Gift wrap on request. We confirm every reservation by phone.
settings.about: Purely Precious Collection is jewellery for days that are not waiting for an occasion. Each piece is considered for how it sits, how it layers, and how it feels at the end of the day. Gold, pearl, and stone — kept quiet on purpose.

catalogs.name: Necklaces
catalogs.description: Chains and pendants cut to sit against the collarbone.

catalogs.name: Earrings
catalogs.description: Studs and hoops light enough to forget, until the light catches them.

catalogs.name: Rings
catalogs.description: Bands and signets shaped for hands that are actually in use.

catalogs.name: Bracelets
catalogs.description: A single line for the wrist, made to stack or to stand alone.

catalogs.name: Bridal
catalogs.description: Ceremony pieces with the same calm as the everyday edit.

catalogs.name: Anklets
catalogs.description: Fine chains meant to sit at the ankle.

products.name: Lune Pendant
products.description: A small round pendant on a fine trace chain, meant to sit at the base of the throat.
products.details: Chain 18 inches, with a 2 inch extender. Lobster clasp. Wipe with a soft cloth and keep perfume off the stone setting.

products.name: Pearl Layer Chain
products.description: Three pearls in a short fall, for wearing alone or over a finer chain.
products.details: Shortest strand sits at 16 inches. Pearls are individually knotted. Store flat, away from other metal.

products.name: Solitaire Studs
products.metal: Cubic zirconia, gold vermeil on silver
products.description: A pair of quiet studs with a low setting, so they sit close and do not catch.
products.details: Butterfly backs included, plus a silicone pair for long wear. Post length 11 mm.

products.name: Crescent Hoops
products.description: Medium hoops with a smooth inner edge, weighted so they hang straight.
products.details: Inner diameter 28 mm. Hinged clasp. Suitable for daily wear once the piercing has healed.

products.name: Signet Pearl Ring
products.description: A flat signet face with one pearl, made to be worn on the index or the little finger.
products.details: Made to a standard size M. Note your size when you reserve and we will confirm the fit.

products.name: Twin Band
products.description: Two slim bands that cross once, so the hand still looks bare from a distance.
products.details: Bands are fixed together. Size M. Avoid chlorine and keep the piece dry overnight.

products.name: Oval Link Cuff
products.description: An open cuff with a soft oval line. It slips on and stays put without a clasp.
products.details: Opening is gentle and can be adjusted once by hand. Inner length about 6.5 inches.

products.name: Temple Petal Haar
products.description: A long layered haar drawn from temple jewellery, kept lighter than the ceremony pieces it remembers.
products.details: Ties at the back with a silk cord. The drop sits at the sternum. Reserve early for wedding dates.

products.name: Bridal Jhumka
products.description: A pair of bells with a single pearl beneath, proportioned for a long evening.
products.details: Hook fittings. Each jhumka weighs under 8 grams. A clutch back is included.
